sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Simple sequencing expressions such as *reggel*, délben, délután and *este* help organise a routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I go to bed in the evening.

sections.content: reggel, délben, délután, este march through the day in order — morning, noon, afternoon, evening — so the easiest way to lock them in is to say them as one chain, like reciting the day itself out loud. Order-based memorization works especially well here because the words are sequenced exactly like the hours they describe.
